command_result.command: cd /app; find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100; cat docs/overview.md; wc -c docs/*
cd /app/docs; cat lending.md exports.md loans.md fees.md output.md changelog.md

cd /app; cat tests/test_fees.py; cat tools/check_fees.py | head -60; cd data; cat policy.ini branches.csv; head -20 calendar.csv patrons.csv waivers.csv exports/manifest.txt; head -3 exports/*cen-2026-12-15.csv exports/wst-2027-01-22.jsonl exports/resend-cen.csv

cd /app/data/exports; ls | grep -v -E '\.(csv|jsonl)$'; for f in *.csv; do head -1 $f; done | sort | uniq -c; cat *.jsonl | python3 -c "
import sys,json,collections
k=collections.Counter();v=collections.Counter()
for l in sys.stdin:
  l=l.lstrip('\ufeff')
  d=json.loads(l);k[tuple(sorted(d))]+=1
  v[('type',d['type'])]+=1;v[('via',d.get('via'))]+=1;v[('it',d.get('item_type'))]+=1;v[('br',d.get('branch'))]+=1
  v[('at',d['at'][19:])]+=1
print(k);print(v)"; grep -c . /app/data/patrons.csv; file *.csv | head -3; grep -l $'\xef\xbb\xbf' * | head; grep -h -c $'\r' * | sort | uniq -c

cd /app/data; cat exports/*.csv | cut -d, -f1-3 | head -0; python3 - <<'E'
import csv,glob,collections
c=collections.Counter()
for f in glob.glob('exports/*.csv'):
  for r in csv.DictReader(open(f,encoding='utf-8-sig')):
    c[('type',r['type'])]+=1;c[('via',r['via'])]+=1;c[('it',r['item_type'])]+=1;c[('br',r['branch'])]+=1
    if r['loan']!=r['loan'].strip() or r['event']!=r['event'].strip(): c['ws']+=1
print(c)
E
awk -F, '{print $2}' patrons.csv | sort | uniq -d | head -3; grep -E 'P-?0*45310|^P-?0*6493' patrons.csv; cut -d, -f4,5 waivers.csv | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -20
cd /app; mkdir -p out; python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -20; python3 bin/fees.py data out/statements.json && python tools/check_fees.py

cd /app; echo '{"status": "success", "summary": "Wrote /app/bin/fees.py implementing the documented rules (exports, voids, local time, due dates, renewals, grace, caps, waivers); ran it on /app/data to /app/out/statements.json. Unit tests pass and check_fees.py matches 228/228 statements and 4/4 branch rows."}' > STATUS.json; python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('STATUS.json')))"
